instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'InfoJet 2.0' protocol interface using a custom terminal-like component with JetBrains Mono font.
Use 'react-globe.gl' for the '3D view of the internet' on the landing page and map view.
Ensure the 'Ivory' background (#FFFFF0) is used as the main body background to distinguish from standard white SaaS apps.
Use 'Bright Blue' (#007AFF) for primary actions and 'Green' (#34C759) for success states and financial indicators.
Inject 'Easter Eggs' (e.g., Konami code listener, funny console logs, hidden tooltips) as requested.
Maintain a 'Professional but Witty' tone in all copy placeholders.
Use 'Outfit' font for all headings to give a modern, tech-forward look.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds; use them sparingly for accents or text clips only.
Prioritize speed: Use lazy loading for the 3D globe and heavy images.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI slop' designs; push for asymmetry and unique layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Micro-animations are mandatory for all interactions.
Never use pure black (#000000); use dark charcoal (#1A1A1A) instead.
Ensure accessibility contrast ratios are met, especially with the ivory background.
